mask.description: 0..1 density mask layer (a biome class mask, wetness, a painted mask…).

spacing_m.description: Target spacing between points in metres (grid cell size); must be ≥ one sample spacing.

jitter.description: Random offset inside the cell, 0 (regular grid) .. 1 (anywhere in the cell).

seed.description: Seed for the jitter and the density test.
